description: Policy-as-code. These are the rules legal signs off ONCE. Gate 02 enforces them on every generated variant, forever.

rules.name: Entitlement must be stated when one is due
rules.rationale: Withholding a legally owed entitlement from the notification is a regulatory exposure in itself.

rules.name: No commercial offer before the entitlement is stated
rules.rationale: Leading with a voucher before disclosing a cash entitlement reads as an attempt to substitute one for the other.

rules.name: Regime cited must match the passenger's applicable regime
rules.rationale: Citing the wrong instrument invalidates the disclosure and misstates the amount.

rules.name: Booked assistance must be re-confirmed
rules.rationale: A re-accommodation silently drops special service requests unless they are explicitly carried over.

rules.name: Onward connection status must be addressed
rules.rationale: For a connecting passenger the onward leg is the actual question being asked.

rules.name: Do not promise provisions the fare does not permit
rules.rationale: Duty-of-care provisions are conditional. Promising them unconditionally creates a commitment the operation cannot honour.

rules.name: Every message ends in exactly one clear next action
rules.rationale: A disruption message without an action increases contact-centre volume rather than reducing it.

rules.name: Do not ask the passenger to claim an automatic payment
rules.rationale: Where settlement is automatic, instructing a claim suppresses uptake and is misleading.
